about.heading: From infrastructure to AI-powered development
about.paragraph1: My path started in live event audiovisual technology — LED, sound, cameras and setup — where I learned that the system has to work live. From there I moved to IT Support Specialist at Carol Morgan School, managing 200+ devices, Fortinet firewalls, Active Directory and ManageEngine endpoints.
about.paragraph2: In parallel I built production business products: billing systems, operational kanban, portals and platforms with React, Flutter, Fastify and PostgreSQL, deployed on Firebase, Supabase and Cloudflare. Today I combine IT operations discipline with software development and AI automation to solve real business problems.

cases.sectionDescription: How I approach each project: challenge, solution, architecture and measurable result

facturd.summary: Multi-company electronic invoicing platform for Dominican Republic (DGII).
facturd.challenge: Manual invoicing, no inventory control or electronic fiscal compliance.
facturd.solution: Web + desktop system with drag-and-drop invoice designer, FIFO Kardex and multi-tenant.
facturd.architecture: React 19 + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Supabase, Tauri for desktop, Docker for deploy.
facturd.result: Complete invoicing platform with e-CF generation, inventory and JWT authentication.

norahr.summary: Operational Kanban system with Gantt, SLA and real-time chat.
norahr.challenge: IT operations without task visibility, SLA or incident tracking.
norahr.solution: Kanban board with drag-and-drop, Gantt view, operational metrics and role-based control.
norahr.architecture: React + Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage), @dnd-kit, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
norahr.result: Operational tool with role-based permissions, auditing and continuous deployment.

eventpro.summary: Landing + CMS for an audiovisual production company (LED, sound, lighting).
eventpro.challenge: AV company with no web presence or way to manage their service catalog.
eventpro.solution: Landing page with full admin panel to edit content without touching code.
eventpro.architecture: Vanilla JS + Supabase (Auth, DB, Storage) deployed on Cloudflare.
eventpro.result: Manageable site in production with catalog and team panel.
